ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the trailing edge boundaries, tips, and scattered circular spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white lobes. High-contrast dark pigmentation is concentrated along the continuous trailing edge and at both distal tips. Multiple small, dark circular blobs are distributed across the white interior field, particularly concentrated in the lower mid-sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center; the base of the notch is partially obscured by water level but the converging linear boundaries indicate a sharp angular convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. The edge consists of repeated, sharp, triangular-shaped peaks (dark pixels) and rounded valleys, creating a jagged, saw-tooth profile isolated against the blue water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to sharply upturned, convex distal tips, creating an overall 'U' shaped macro-structure.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular pixel clusters (rosettes) scattered across the white surface. Higher density of irregular, dark, raised-texture clusters at the terminal ends of both tips, consistent with barnacle colonization points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of dark, roughly vertical linear pixel disruptions located on the far left lobe, breaking the continuous white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark rosette scars and textured clusters at the tips; visible vertical linear rake-like marks on the left lobe; jagged, irregular missing segments in the serration pattern on the right lobe.
